transfers.title: Airport & station transfers
transfers.body: Fixed fares from nine airports and the Brenner-line railway stations to your hotel door.

excursions.title: Day excursions
excursions.body: Sella Ronda, Venice, Verona, Innsbruck and Lake Garda with a private driver who knows the road.

local.title: Local taxi in Val Gardena

routes.title: Airports & stations we serve
routes.subtitle: Indicative fares for a standard car. The booking calculator shows the exact price for your vehicle and date.

steps.title: How it works

book.title: Book in two minutes
book.body: Enter your route, see the exact price and confirm online. No prepayment.

confirm.title: We confirm and watch your flight
confirm.body: Dispatch confirms your driver and follows your flight on the day of travel.

meet.body: Look for the name board. Luggage, skis and child seats are handled for you.

arrive.title: Relax to your door
